answer: The Dedicated device bound by DNS record proof with annual re-verification makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Even a quiet zenith gets heard, because binding weighs evidence, not volume. When the lagoon settles over the walnut, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
